summary: 0.2.5-rc.1 is a prerelease candidate for CEE 1.1.4 compatibility and panel wiring with PG tools. API 1.0.0 and existing saves stay compatible.
changes: Support CEE 1.1.4 while retaining 1.1.3, including correct variac voltage and heating readings.
Reveal CEE panel terminals when holding PG or Gauged wire tools and select recessed front terminals without bypassing walls or reach limits.
Retain native CEE tools and existing electrical behavior. Focused Native/Java checks passed; complete headless and live graphical acceptance remain outstanding.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3 or 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. These candidate fixes were checked on Windows with NeoForge 21.1.248. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
